articles.summary: Palus Finance is using Modern Treasury’s Payments API to power ACH, wire, and RTP payments for its automated treasury platform. With Modern Treasury’s infrastructure, Palus helps startups and SMBs optimize liquidity, move funds seamlessly, and earn higher yield on idle cash.
articles.title: Palus Finance Selects Modern Treasury to Power Multi-Rail Payments for Treasury Management

articles.summary: This partnership strengthens Spritz’s vision of a unified financial experience by enabling seamless movement between bank accounts and stablecoins through a single API.
articles.title: Spritz Selects Modern Treasury to Unify Multi-Rail Consumer Payments

articles.summary: Modern Treasury launched Global USD Accounts, enabling platforms to offer named U.S. dollar accounts in 90+ countries with ACH, wire, RTP, FedNow, stablecoin support, compliance, and real-time ledgering.
articles.title: Modern Treasury Launches Global USD Accounts, Enabling Platforms to Serve Users in 90+ Countries
